data.investment_objective: The scheme has adopted a passive investment strategy. The scheme invests in stocks comprising the Nifty 50 index in the sameproportion as in the index with the objective of achieving returns equivalent to the Total Returns Index of Nifty 50 index byminimizing the performance diﬀerence between the benchmark index and the Scheme. The Total Returns Index is an indexthat reﬂects the returns on the index from index gain/ loss plus dividend payments by the constituent stocks.
